answer: When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 6 times its size, so a group of 96 keys loses far more than 96 single identities would. The vine graph is rebuilt each epoch, which means the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the timber audit merges it again. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the opal checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
